variety_description: High yield, medium maturity, semi-dwarf, medium slender variety suitable for rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by BINA and released in 2013 for planting in Aman season in submerged areas of Bangladesh. Tolerant to leaf blast and sheath blight. Susceptible to stagnant water conditions.
